title: pilosella kalksburgensis subsp. pleiantha
intro: Pilosella kalksburgensis subsp. pleiantha, commonly known as a type of dandelion, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family, characterized by its yellow flowers and medicinal properties. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella kalksburgensis subsp. pleiantha are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may have anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and cardiovascular-protective effects. However, further research is necessary to confirm the exact therapeutic actions and health benefits of this plant.
